title: Create useful review material on the first change
statement: As a first-time change author, I can begin by explaining only the current implementation change, so that I get useful review material without completing the whole documentation model.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A first-change workflow asks the author to explain every changed line.
The first-change workflow does not require personas, stories, design, or test cases.
The first-change workflow ends once the current change is explained.
After the first workflow, the author is offered optional documentation growth.
The author can reorganize first-run content later without breaking existing links.
